parameters.metadata_filter: apply only when explicitly present in the user query benchmark

selection_rule: Choose the highest dev Context Evidence Rate; on a tie, choose the smaller average context size to limit downstream LLM tokens.

dev_basis.comparison: Hybrid top_k=5, budget=1200 also reached 12/20, with 952.4 average context chars.

test_policy: Run only the BM25 baseline and this selected configuration; do not adjust after inspecting test results.
